cards.text: 【CONT】 If your stock has 3 or less cards, this card gets the following ability. "【AUTO】 When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may put the top card of your deck into your stock."

cards.name: “Providing Magic” Aqua
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your other "“Crimson Demon” Megumin" get the following ability. "【AUTO】 At the beginning of your encore step, you may put the top card of your opponent's deck into their waiting room. If you do, choose 1 card in your opponent's waiting room, and put it on the top of their deck."

【CONT】 All of your other 《Adventurer》 or 《Goddess》 characters get +500 power and "【AUTO】 Encore [Put 1 character from your hand into your waiting room]".
